currency.description: Fiat currency code, such as USD

expiration-days.description: Days until the pending order expires; 0 uses the node's default

fiat-amount.description: Fiat amount; with --fiat-amount-max, the range minimum

fiat-amount-max.description: Range maximum: makes a range order at market price

invoice.description: Lightning invoice, when the order needs one

premium.description: Premium on the price, in percent

sats.description: Sats amount; 0 means the market price

side.description: The order's side: buy or sell (case-insensitive)

yes.description: Create the order without asking (required with --output json)
